name: Tabs
summary: Switch between peer views in the same context.

a11y.keyboardNote: Re-measured in a browser on 29/08/2026 (apps/keyboard-probe + tests/visual/teclado-motor.spec.ts). Confirmed: ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home, End — the four the ficha declares. What the arrows DO is a choice since G-API-02: with `activateOnFocus` (the default, and what Aurea always did) the arrow moves focus and switches the panel; with `activateOnFocus={false}` it only moves focus and Enter/Space activates, which is the APG's manual pattern and the right one when switching a tab costs a network round trip. That behaviour is measured in tests/unit/components.test.tsx, and the test was proven against the defect: with the literal `activateOnFocus` back in the JSX, the manual case fails.

props.name: tabs
props.type: Array<{id: string; label: ReactNode; content: ReactNode}>
props.description: Tab and panel together, because they are one thing: a tab with no panel is a button.

props.name: value
props.description: The id of the open tab. Controlled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Fires on click and on arrow keys.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the tab list.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Resolved at runtime and handed to the engine, which publishes data-orientation/aria-orientation and adapts the arrow keys.

props.name: activateOnFocus
props.description: Automatic activation: the arrow switches the panel along with focus. Set false for the APG's manual pattern — the arrow moves focus and Enter/Space activates. Use false when switching a tab is expensive.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether the arrow wraps from the last tab back to the first.
